geography: Worldwide (Shire 'LIALDA' row in 2007, then 'LIALDA/MEZAVANT' - the same mesalamine MMX product sold as Mezavant outside the U.S.)

approval_evidence.quote: 01/16/2007 ORIG-1 Approval Type 3 - New Dosage Form STANDARD; Orphan (NDA 022000, LIALDA MESALAMINE)

launch_evidence.quote: Since the launch of LIALDA in March 2007, PENTASA and LIALDA's combined share of the US oral mesalamine prescription market had grown to 24.9% as at December 31, 2007

series_start_reason: LIALDA was launched in March 2007; Shire's Q1 2007 release (filed 2007-04-25) prints no LIALDA row, and the first row is the Q2 2007 release (5.0), one quarter after launch.
series_end_reason: Takeda completed its acquisition of Shire on January 8, 2019. Shire's last quarter is printed in 'Shire's Full Year 2018 Results' (Takeda Form 6-K filed 2019-02-15, row 'LIALDA/MEZAVANT | 96.0 | 99.8 | 383.0 | 569.4'). Takeda's sec.gov filings print a LIALDA line in only one document: the underlying-revenue table of its FY2019 Q1 Quarterly Securities Report (Form 6-K filed 2019-08-09, row 'Lialda | 11.7 | (0.1) | 5.6 ...', Bn JPY, April-June 2018 pro-forma and April-June 2019). No other Takeda report or 20-F (tk.py list, FY2018 Q4 to FY2026 Q1) has a Lialda revenue row, and January-March 2019 is printed by neither issuer, so the line cannot be continued past 2018Q4 without a gap longer than one quarter.
search_log: Listed every Shire plc (CIK 936402) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (all forms); fetched every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2004-07 to 2019-02 whose items include 2.02, 12, 9 or 7.01 (or carry none), with every exhibit from each filing's index.json, plus every 10-Q/10-K primary document; table rows naming the brand were extracted from every exhibit (rows.py).

Takeda (CIK 1395064): 'Shire's Full Year 2018 Results' (Form 6-K filed 2019-02-15) and Takeda's earnings documents furnished on Form 6-K/20-F for FY2018 Q4 to FY2026 Q1 (the per-quarter list in tk.py) were fetched and searched for the brand.
Each quarter: three-month row of the brand in the release reporting it as current (smallest of the brand's rows before 2016Q2, the Total/prior/year-to-date row from 2016Q2).
